notes.piece: A ringed gas giant rising over the horizon of a small airless moon, seen from its surface.
notes.light: The sun is low, off to the right and in front: every sphere is gibbous with its night side on the left, the rings throw a thin shadow on the planet, the planet's shadow cuts the back ring on the left, and ground shadows fall long to the left.
notes.layers: Stars, back ring, planet, night side, ring shadow, front ring, ground; hand-painted detail goes on top.
